Game Overview

At its heart, Princess Curse is a makeup game about help a young princess break free from a wicked spell and restore her natural beauty. Unleash your creativity as you transform her appearance to win her prince's heart. Immerse yourself in this enchanting, easy-to-play adventure that's accessible on any device. Transform the princess and witness true magic!
